paper.title: Expression pattern, subcellular localization of Aspergillus oryzae ergosterol synthases, and their effects on ergosterol and fatty acid metabolism.
paper.authors: Tian X, Qin K, Deng Y, Xue P, Huang C, Liu S, Hu Z.
paper.association_evidence: Data availability statement: sequencing data deposited in NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA1188350 and BioSample SAMN44832574 (Europe PMC full-text accession search).

study_summary.objective: Characterise A. oryzae ergosterol synthase genes and test how overexpressing them changes ergosterol and fatty acid metabolism.
study_summary.experimental_design: RNA-seq of the RIB40 control and the AoErg7B- and AoHmgB-overexpression strains, one pooled sample each (three cultures pooled), no replicates.
study_summary.main_finding: AoErg7B-OE had 5,006 and AoHmgB-OE 1,807 differentially expressed genes versus the control, 1,235 shared; AoHmgB-OE gave the highest ergosterol content.

notes: The overexpressed genes (AoErg7B, AoHmgB) are driven by the pEX2B construct, so their TPM in the OE runs is construct-driven; candidate for the construct-expression table (TODO, Construct-driven expression). The paper text gives gene names but not AO09 identifiers.

Curated strains: RIB40 for the control as labelled, RIB40_OE-Erg7B and RIB40_OE-HmgB for the overexpression strains (suffix convention agreed with the user, 2026-11-04); the OE background is RIB40 DeltapyrG DeltaHis.

The SRA records say NovaSeq 6000 while the paper says HiSeq 2500. Culture medium, time and temperature of the RNA-seq cultures are not stated in the retrieved text. The three runs share one BioSample but are different strains, so they count as three independent samples.
